name: OWASP Citizen Development Top 10
source_notes: Current CD-SEC list from the owasp.org Citizen Development project page and repo; legacy LCNC-SEC list from the old owasp.org LCNC page.
caveats: Renamed from "OWASP Top 10 Low-Code/No-Code Security Risks" (LCNC-SEC-01..10) to "OWASP Citizen Development Top 10" (CD-SEC-01..10); the old owasp.org page still shows the LCNC list. No exact rename date was found (2025 branding).
legacy_id/legacy_name are arrays: CD-SEC-04 merges LCNC-SEC-03 and LCNC-SEC-08 (per the notes); CD-SEC-01 Blind Trust is new and has no legacy ID; other mappings match identical titles.
Detail pages keep "2022" in their URL path despite the rebrand.
Only the CD-SEC-04 detail text was captured; other summaries paraphrase titles and CD-SEC-01 Blind Trust detail was not read.
Maturity 'lab' is inferred from front-matter level 3.
detection.static entries are reinhardt rule ideas, not OWASP text.

items.name: Blind Trust
items.summary: Components, connectors or generated logic are trusted without review (newly added item; detail text not captured).

static: AI-generated code adding connectors/SDKs that were never reviewed (reinhardt undisclosed-recipient check)

items.name: Account Impersonation
items.summary: Apps or connections run under another identity, letting users act with someone else's privileges.

review: Platform/configuration concern; requires review of the low-code platform settings

items.name: Authorization Misuse
items.summary: Shared connections and permissions are misused to access data or actions beyond what is intended.

review: Platform/configuration concern; requires review of the low-code platform settings

items.name: Sensitive Data Leakage and Handling Failures
items.summary: Platforms cannot tell which fields are sensitive, so PII and secrets leak through syncs, AI assistants, hardcoded connection strings and unsanitized webhook logs.
prevention: Monitor data flows that cross organizational boundaries.
Monitor environment variables and databases for leaked sensitive data.

static: Hardcoded connection strings or secrets in app variables/config
Webhook handlers that log entire request bodies unsanitized
Raw support logs or user data passed to AI assistants
Connectors/SDKs sending data to services across organizational boundaries

items.name: Authentication and Secure Communication Failures
items.summary: Weak authentication or insecure communication between apps, connectors and services.

review: Platform/configuration concern; requires review of the low-code platform settings

items.name: Vulnerable and Untrusted Components
items.summary: Third-party or community components with vulnerabilities or unknown provenance are used.

static: Dependencies with known vulnerabilities or unknown provenance

items.name: Security Misconfiguration
items.summary: Insecure platform or app settings expose data or functionality.

review: Platform/configuration concern; requires review of the low-code platform settings

items.name: Injection Handling Failures
items.summary: Untrusted input reaches queries, formulas or commands without proper handling.

review: Platform/configuration concern; requires review of the low-code platform settings

items.name: Asset Management Failures
items.summary: Apps, connections and data flows are not inventoried or maintained.

review: Platform/configuration concern; requires review of the low-code platform settings

items.name: Security Logging and Monitoring Failures
items.summary: Insufficient logging and monitoring of app activity.

review: Platform/configuration concern; requires review of the low-code platform settings
